acceptance: A reviewed, documented emergency procedure exists, including the per-PR owner approval, the reason record, and the follow-up issue
The procedure requires confirming the failure on current develop before a bypass
The develop ruleset shows zero bypass actors again with enforcement active
context: Incident 2026-10-14: a stale scope-ledger entry failed every PR's comment gate. Repair PR #2953 could not merge normally (gate pins the base copy) and the develop-squash-only ruleset listed zero bypass actors, so even admin API merge was refused. Resolved with owner approval via temporary org-admin pull_request bypass, immediate merge, and verified restore. Later finding: PR #2954 had already removed the stranded ledger entries about 11 hours before #2953 merged, so #2953's bypass fixed nothing that was still broken; its squash adds only a 14-line test. Owner, 2026-10-15, Claude session e0e74e6b, question dialog: "Agents may bypass with approval" — an agent may bypass required checks only after the owner approves that specific PR in the current request, records the reason, and opens a follow-up issue (now [MERGE-AUTHORITY-001] and docs/agent/merge-authority.md). The written procedure must confirm the gate is still broken on current develop before any bypass.
description: There is no standing break-glass path for base-pinned gate breakage: with zero bypass actors, the next all-PR-blocking outage requires improvising repo security changes under pressure again. Record the emergency procedure (temporary org-admin pull_request bypass, merge, immediate verified restore) or pre-approve a standing break-glass actor, with the exact commands and verification checks, and get it reviewed before the next incident.
